sloka: सा तप्तनवहेमाभा तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणा ।पपात ज्वलनं दीप्तं सर्वलोकस्य सन्निधौ ।। ६.११९.३० ।।
transliteration: sā taptanavahemābhā taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇā ।papāta jvalanaṁ dīptaṁ sarvalokasya sannidhau ।। 6.119.30 ।।

translations.english: Young and old assembled there, and the gathering of people witnessed Mythili entering the flaming and burning fire.
